description: List the tasks in an event (task list). status "open" returns only tasks with no completion yet: use it when checking for work to do, so a long list is not re-read in full. "done" returns only completed tasks; "all" (default) returns every task.

status.description: open = not completed yet (use this to find work), done = completed, all = everything (default).

name: tascan_list_tasks
